import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    mean_util = np.mean(utilities)
    std_util = np.std(utilities)
    
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    
    if std_util > 1e-8:
        z_scores = (utilities - mean_util) / std_util
        # Target outlier edges with utility significantly above the mean
        mask = z_scores > 1.0
        if not np.any(mask):
            mask = utilities >= np.max(utilities)
            excess = np.ones_like(utilities[mask])
        else:
            excess = z_scores[mask]
        
        # Penalties scaled proportionally by z-score excess
        base_penalty = 0.25 * avg_edge
        penalties = base_penalty * (1.0 + 0.5 * excess)
    else:
        mask = utilities >= np.max(utilities)
        penalties = 0.25 * avg_edge
    
    sel_u = u_idx[mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[mask]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalties
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalties
    
    return updated_edge_distance
